title: RankQ: Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning via Self-Supervised Action Ranking
abstract: arXiv:2605.11151v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Offline-to-online reinforcement learning (RL) improves sample efficiency by leveraging pre-collected datasets prior to online interaction. A key challenge, however, is learning an accurate critic in large state--action spaces with limited dataset coverage. To mitigate harmful updates from value overestimation, prior methods impose pessimism by down-weighting out-of-distribution (OOD) actions relative to dataset actions. While effective, this essentially acts as a behavior cloning anchor and can hinder downstream online policy improvement when dataset actions are suboptimal. translated_title: RankQ：通过自监督动作排序实现离线到在线强化学习
translated_abstract: 离线到在线强化学习（RL）通过在在线交互之前利用预先收集的数据集来提高样本效率。然而，一个关键挑战是在数据集覆盖有限的大型状态-动作空间中学习准确的评论家（critic）网络。为了缓解价值高估带来的有害更新，先前的方法通过降低分布外（OOD）动作相对于数据集动作的权重来施加悲观主义。虽然有效，但这本质上起到了行为克隆锚点的作用，当数据集动作并非最优时，可能会阻碍下游的在线策略改进。我们提出了RankQ，这是一种离线到在线的Q学习目标，它通过自监督的多项排序损失来增强时序差分学习，以强制执行结构化的动作排序。通过学习相对动作偏好而不是统一惩罚未见过的动作，RankQ塑造了Q函数，使动作梯度指向更高质量的（原文此处截断）
tldr: RankQ提出了一种离线到在线Q学习方法，通过自监督排序损失学习动作间的相对偏好来塑造Q函数，使动作梯度指向更高质量的动作，避免了传统悲观方法充当行为克隆锚点而阻碍在线策略改进的问题。
en_tdlr: RankQ is an offline-to-online Q-learning method that augments temporal-difference learning with a self-supervised ranking loss to learn relative action preferences, directing action gradients toward higher-quality actions and avoiding the behavior-cloning anchor problem of pessimistic OOD action penalization.
